requirement_text.REQ-149: Decision-and-design requirement that unblocks REQ-156 (LUA-09). Produce lib/letflow/design/req149-lua-memory-limit.md that: (1) empirically establishes whether the adopted runtime (tv-labs/lua, per REQ-148) exposes any memory-limit or allocation-accounting option at all -- search deps/lua/ source and quote what was found; (2) evaluates at minimum: bounded :max_heap_size on the script's executing process, periodic host-side sampling of Process.info(pid, :memory), and declining the graceful-failure clause outright; (3) reaches an explicit RECOMMENDED MECHANISM stating which of LUA-09's two clauses (fail gracefully / terminate the script) it satisfies; (4) explicitly rejects approximating memory via :max_instructions per decision 0014's own instruction. Whether this produces a new record in docs/migration/decisions/ or an addendum to 0014 is this requirement's own call; if the outcome contradicts anything 0014 states, it is an addendum with REVIEWER sign-off.
